introHtml: Can coffee mugs offer a sleek, modern alternative to traditional ceramic or glass mugs. Their straight-sided shape provides a large, smooth surface for crisp logo imprinting, making them a favorite for corporate gifts and promotional events. Whether you choose stainless steel for insulation or ceramic for a classic feel, these mugs hold 10 to 16 ounces and stack easily for storage. Perfect for breakrooms or client giveaways.
